Author: T. Amarnath Goud

 High Court Of Tripura
 Agartala
 Ia No.01 Of 2025
 In Crl.A(J) No.32 Of 2025
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice T. Amarnath Goud
 Present:
 For the Applicant(s) : Mr. Sankar Lodh, Advocate.
 Mr. S. Majumder, Advocate.
 For the Respondent(s) : Mr. B. Majumder, Deputy Sgi.
10.04.2025 Order

In this case, the appellants, namely Smt. Kalpana Debnath (Applicant No.1), Sri Sanjay Debnath (Applicant No.2), and Sri Kamal Krishna Debnath (Appellant No.3), were convicted by the Learned Special Judge (CBI), West Tripura, Agartala, in Special (CBI) 05 of 2024.
Applicants No.1 and No.2 were found guilty of offences punishable under Sections 468, 420, and 120B read with Sections 468 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

They were each sentenced to undergo Rigorous Imprisonment for 4 (four) years on each count, along with a fine of Rs. 20,000/- under Section 468 IPC (in default, to undergo 1 month of Simple Imprisonment), Rs. 15,000/- under Section 420 IPC (in default, 20 days of Simple Imprisonment), and Rs. 20,000/- under Section 120B IPC read with Sections 468 and 420 IPC (in default, 20 days of Simple Imprisonment).

Applicant No.3 was convicted under Section 120B read with Section 420 IPC and sentenced to Rigorous Imprisonment for 4 (four) years and a fine of Rs. 20,000/-, in default whereof he shall suffer 20 days of Simple Imprisonment.

Heard Mr. S. Lodh, learned counsel appearing for the applicants, as well as Mr. B. Majumder,
learned Deputy Solicitor General of India, appearing for the respondent-CBI.
Mr. Lodh, learned counsel for the applicants, submitted that in similar related cases, the applicants had been granted interim suspension upon depositing the fine amount before the concerned Court.
On the other hand, the learned Deputy SGI prayed for time to file an objection.

In view of the submission made by the learned counsel for the applicants, the interim suspension petition is allowed, subject to the condition that the applicants deposit the fine amount before the Unknown vs For The on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133933312/
1 Registry of this High Court on or before 16.04.2025.
Upon such deposit, the High Court shall issue a certified copy of the said interim order.
The applicants shall also furnish two sureties of Rs. 25,000/- each and a personal bond of the same amount before the concerned Court.
However, liberty is granted to the learned Deputy SGI to file a modification petition, if any, as per procedure.
With the above observations and directions, the present suspension petition stands disposed of.
JUDGE  suhanjit RAJKUMAR SUHANJIT SINGHA SUHANJIT SINGHA Date: 2025.04.10 14:14:53 +05'30'
